acceptedJointRecommendation: Accept the intact constrained rig and static exports with explicit contact-density and live-cadence limits. Do not attribute mixed idle one-second gaps to SVG without evidence.
practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement: Before a website motion change, record purpose/frequency, driver and animated properties. Separate immediate UI response from requested character content; apply review-animations to both with explicit purpose-based exceptions.

Use choreograph to map causal moments and supporting channels before editing: antenna notices, gaze/head attend, feet contact, head recovers, mitten offers. Sequence only when that relationship carries meaning; preserve still consideration beats.

Use animate's retarget-from-current-state reasoning and the existing finite scheduler for character interruptions. Keep a small set of meaningful regression cases: rest entry, replay, mid-hop switching, reflective-to-joy, reduced-motion changes, pause/resume, hidden/offscreen state and teardown.

Use animation-performance to compare an active run with an appropriate control and capture a rendering trace before assigning cause. Treat path writes and the night filter as candidates to measure, not established culprits; do not add blanket will-change.

For material character changes, pair exact numeric samples with actual-size PNG/contact sheets and continuous playback at the same source version. For website integration, add physical-device/crop/lifecycle checks. Keep source invariants, sample images, live cadence, subjective playback and human research as distinct evidence categories.
Hand future engineers specific source/evidence findings and acceptance cases. Both independent numbers remain visible; skills checklists and pair agreement do not replace craft judgment.
skillsExceptions: Sub-300ms UI budgets and no-keyboard-feedback animation rules do not remove a requested multi-second character performance activated by keyboard. Its controls still need prompt, equivalent access.

Transform/opacity preferences do not authorize replacing expressive SVG deformation, flattening wing layers or enlarging tiny anatomy. Optimize measured costs while preserving geometry and authored trajectories.
A static expressive reduced-motion state is valid here; no extra fade or decorative stagger is required.
The independent-review protocol determines JSON output and prohibits source edits; construction-skill output requirements do not override it.
